description: Source code implementing MD4 cryptographic hash functions, including initialization, transformation, update, and finalization routines, based on RFC 1186.

methods.name: MD4
methods.description: Computes MD4 hash of input data.

methods.name: MD4_Init
methods.description: Initializes MD4 context with standard initial values.

methods.name: MD4_Transform
methods.description: Performs MD4 transformation on a single block.

methods.name: MD4_Update
methods.description: Updates MD4 context with additional data.

methods.name: MD4_Final
methods.description: Finalizes MD4 hash computation and outputs digest.
